title: Concept: JDBC URL carrying a user parameter
description: A JDBC URL that carries a user parameter in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The URL names the database host, the schema and the account, and drivers often accept a password parameter next to it, so the whole connection detail is one string.
applicability: Deployments that render a JDBC URL that carries a user parameter into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The URL names the database host, the schema and the account, and drivers often accept a password parameter next to it, so the whole connection detail is one string.
